name: Empty Folders
description: Folders that contain no files at any depth. Rules are tried in order and the first match wins; only the Empty Folders tool reads this pack.

rules.reason: Windows and your apps expect this standard folder to exist, even when it is empty, so it is left alone.
Empty folder in your temp folder, untouched for more than 7 days; programs recreate these when they need them.
Empty folder in your temp folder, but it changed within the last 7 days, so a running program may still be about to use it.
Empty folder inside one of your personal folders. You may have created it on purpose, so check before removing it.
Empty folder in application data. An app may expect this folder to exist, so check before removing it.
Empty folder in shared application data. An app may expect this folder to exist, so it is shown for information and never offered for removal.
This folder holds no files at any depth. It may be a leftover, or it may be a placeholder you made on purpose.
